title: Book 8 — Urania, Chapter 72
paragraphs: Those of the Greeks who came in full force to the Isthmus to help their country were these: the Lacedaemonians, Arcadians of every division, Eleians, Corinthians, Sikyonians, Epidaurians, Phliasians, Troizenians, and Hermionians. These were the ones who came to Greece's aid in her danger and felt alarm for her, while the rest of the Peloponnesians showed no concern — and by this time the Olympic and Carnean festivals had passed.
